# The Great Hive

*Godwin has been stung four times since spring. Follow the Chalk Hive bees to where they all fly: the great hive at the Hive Hollow's mouth.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Story |
| Given by | [Godwin](../npcs/godwin.md) |
| Level | 27 |
| After | [Blank on the Map](../quests/gervase_blank_on_the_map.md) |
| Leads to | [Queen of the Downs](../quests/edric_queen_of_the_downs.md), [A Calm Garden](../quests/godwin_a_calm_garden.md) |

## Objectives

1. Defeat 30 [Chalk Hive Bee](../monsters/chalk_hive_bee.md)
2. Reach the Hive Hollow's mouth in [The Chalk Hives](../maps/chalk_hives.md)

## Rewards

- 10,600 EXP
- 600 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x20
- +40 standing with Selsior
- +150 standing with [Godwin](../npcs/godwin.md)
- Unlocks `boss.queen_amberwing`
